description: This file implements a vector data structure for handling Segmentation and Reassembly (SAR) payloads used during end-to-end session context management. It provides functions for initialization, validation, appending payloads, serialization, and cleanup of SAR payload vectors.

methods.name: bool IsValidPayload(sar_vector_t * sarv,sar_payload_t * new_payload)
methods.description: Validates if a new SAR payload can be appended based on session ID and sequence ID consistency.

methods.name: void SAR_VECTOR_Init(sar_vector_t * sarv)
methods.description: Initializes a SAR vector structure by resetting its fields.

methods.name: bool SAR_VECTOR_Append(sar_vector_t * sarv,uint64_t sess_id,uint64_t seq_id,uint8_t * data,int len)
methods.description: Appends a new payload to the SAR vector after validation, performing a deep copy of the payload data.

methods.name: void SAR_VECTOR_Destroy(sar_vector_t * sarv)
methods.description: Frees all dynamically allocated memory associated with the SAR vector.

methods.name: sar_payload_t * SAR_VECTOR_Get(sar_vector_t * sarv,unsigned index)
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to a payload at a specific index in the SAR vector.

methods.name: uint8_t * SAR_VECTOR_Serialize(sar_vector_t * sarv,int * len)
methods.description: Serializes all payloads in the vector into a contiguous buffer; caller takes ownership of this buffer.

ctags.name: SAR_VECTOR_Append
ctags.pattern: /^bool SAR_VECTOR_Append(sar_vector_t *sarv, uint64_t sess_id, uint64_t seq_id, uint8_t *data, int/
